description: The MIT-licensed companion code predicts long-term US residential water demand using a pooled climate-region formulation and a utility-specific multiple-linear-regression baseline. This resource is provided by alexa586. Coverage is national as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists ZIP formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: MIT. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The provider says the paper was submitted to Nature Water. Submission does not establish acceptance or scientific validation. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
